steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Configure the closest supported auction type; the requested English rising strategy is not available as a catalog argument.
Apply the first available auction template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add the requested product and quantity where the catalog supports them.
Invite three QA vendors without inventing vendor names.
Publish the auction so vendors can bid.
Assert that the event reached a published project page.
Submit the first vendor bid at 100.
Assert that the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit the second vendor bid at 105.
Assert that the second vendor bid was accepted.
Assert that the buyer sees both direct vendor responses and the correct participation count.
